text: The company's hiring process consists of five stages: resume screening, an online assessment, a technical interview, a managerial interview, and an HR discussion.
Candidates who successfully complete all stages receive an offer letter within seven working days.
The standard probation period for new employees is six months.

Employees can refer candidates through the internal employee referral portal. A referral bonus of INR 25,000 is provided after the referred candidate successfully completes three months of employment.
Candidates who are not selected can reapply for the same position after six months.
All new employees must submit their identity proof, educational certificates, previous employment documents, PAN card, and bank account details during onboarding.
Employees must complete mandatory information security and workplace ethics training within the first 30 days of joining.
The standard working hours are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday.
Employees are eligible to work from home for two days per week with prior managerial approval.
The HR department conducts performance reviews twice a year, in June and December.

Every full-time employee is entitled to 18 earned leaves, 12 sick leaves, and 6 casual leaves per calendar year. Employees can carry forward a maximum of 10 unused earned leaves to the following year.
Unused sick leaves and casual leaves expire at the end of the calendar year.
Planned leave requests must be submitted through the employee portal at least three working days in advance.
Emergency sick leave can be communicated directly to the reporting manager.
Employees taking more than three consecutive sick leaves must provide a medical certificate.
The company provides group health insurance coverage of INR 5,00,000 per year for employees, their spouses, and up to two dependent children.
Employees may include their parents in the insurance plan by paying an additional annual premium.
Cashless treatment is available at approved network hospitals.
Employees can claim up to INR 15,000 annually for eligible outpatient consultations, prescribed medicines, and diagnostic tests.
Medical reimbursement requests must be submitted within 30 days of treatment, along with original bills and prescriptions.
Approved claims are processed within 15 working days.
The Resource Centre provides employees with laptops, monitors, testing devices, software licenses, and technical equipment required for project development.
Employees must raise a resource request through the internal service portal.
Standard equipment requests are processed within three working days.
Employees are responsible for maintaining the equipment assigned to them. Any damage, loss, or malfunction must be reported to the Resource Centre within 24 hours.
All company-issued equipment must be returned during the employee's exit clearance process.
Personal installation of unauthorized software is strictly prohibited.
All software development projects must follow the company's coding standards and version control guidelines.
Developers must create separate feature branches for new implementations and bug fixes.
Every code change requires approval from at least two reviewers before merging into the main branch.
Automated unit tests must pass before deployment.

Production deployments are scheduled on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 6:00 PM and 9:00 PM. Critical production issues must be reported immediately to the technical support team. Developers must maintain updated technical documentation, including API specifications, architecture diagrams, dependency details, and troubleshooting procedures.
Employees travelling for official business must obtain managerial approval before booking transportation and accommodation.
Domestic hotel expenses are reimbursed up to INR 4,000 per night, while international accommodation is reimbursed up to INR 10,000 per night.
Economy-class flight tickets are permitted for official business travel.
Employees receive a daily meal allowance of INR 1,000 for domestic travel and INR 3,000 for international travel.
Travel reimbursement claims must be submitted within 15 days of completing the trip, along with invoices, boarding passes, and payment receipts.
Approved expenses are reimbursed within 10 working days.
